title: Sonographic Assessment and Visualization of Ectopics in Emergency Medicine
brief_summary: Observational study of the use of ultrasound by emergency physicians in the evaluation of patients at risk of ectopic pregnancy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* pregnant females in 1st trimester
* present to emergency department
* complaint of abdominal/pelvic pain or vaginal bleeding

Exclusion Criteria:

* previous ultrasound diagnostic of location of pregnancy
study_population: women at risk of ectopic pregnancy in emergency department
